subject.title: feat: preview spreadsheets and slide decks

question: Should ClickClack accept bounded parsing of untrusted XLSX/PPTX archives on the browser main thread as part of the artifact viewer?
rationale: Tests and proof support the implementation, but CI cannot decide whether the remaining browser-availability boundary is an acceptable permanent product tradeoff.

options.title: Accept bounded browser parsing
options.body: Merge after pending checks pass, retaining the documented budgets, text-only behavior, and authenticated fallback.

options.title: Keep Office download-only
options.body: Decline this parsing boundary and continue serving spreadsheet and slide-deck attachments only through authenticated download.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded browser parsing
recommendation.body: Merge after pending checks pass, retaining the documented budgets, text-only behavior, and authenticated fallback.
